column4: [proudly] Good morning, wanderers. This is Kyoto Dreams Radio, broadcasting from the house that never ends. I am Takeshi Moriyama, retainer of the Moriyama house, keeper of the morning.
[dry] It is always morning here, Takeshi. You are keeper of nothing. I am Hana Kurosawa. Welcome, lost ones.
[offended] I am keeper of the MICROPHONE. Which I was holding. Before you took it.
[calm] You were holding it upside down.
[shouting] A samurai holds a blade any way he WISHES!
[sighs] It is not a blade. It is a microphone. Here is a song. Please.
[nostalgic] Listeners ask how a samurai comes to sit in a radio booth. I will tell you. I fell asleep on a battlefield, in the year of Sekigahara.
[quietly] I woke in a hot spring. Steam, cedar, a lantern swaying. I thought I had died, and the gods were kind.
[amused] Then the Sector of Amaterasu fished him out and gave him almond water. He tried to duel the bottle.
[indignant] It looked at me with disrespect!
[softly] I came another way. I slept in a dark hotel and woke on the porch, dew on my sleeves. My sword was still in my hand. [pause] It always is.
[grudging] Her sword is... adequate.
[sharp] Adequate?
[annoyed] Today's bulletin. The Sector kitchen has posted the meal list on the refrigerator. Someone has written "Takeshi is a fool" beside the rice.
[innocent] How strange.
[furious, shouting] It is in YOUR brushwork, Kurosawa! I would know that stroke anywhere! [yelling] HANA!
[laughing] You should be honored. I spelled your name correctly.
[screaming] I will NOT be honored! I will be AVENGED!
[calm] You will be eating, in ten minutes, because Irawan made curry. Sit down.
[muttering, defeated] ...curry is acceptable.

[serious, measured] A samurai's day begins before dawn. Here, dawn never ends, so I begin whenever I wake. Cold water on the face. One hundred cuts in the open studio. Then the blade is cleaned, with paper and oil.
[serious] My father taught me the sword is not for winning. It is for the moment you must not lose. I was the only daughter in our dojo. I trained twice as long to be given half the respect.
[quiet] ...I did not know that.
[gentle] You never asked. You were busy losing to me.
[snapping] I did not LOSE. The floor was wet!
[dry] The floor is wooden, Takeshi. It is never wet.
[shouting] IT WAS WET IN MY HEART!
[warm] Advice for travelers. Kyoto Dreams is safe. No entities walk these halls. Take a futon, take a towel, take a meal from the fridge. Leave your shoes at the step.
[stern] And do not touch the swords in the cabinets. They belong to the house. The house remembers who touches them.
[amused] He touched one his first night. The cabinet closed on his fingers.
[sulking] The cabinet and I have since made peace.
[serious] If you must leave, sleep in the hot spring. You may wake in another level. But some never come back to tell us where.
[hesitant] Listeners. There is something I must confess on air. The Moriyama house fought at Sekigahara... under the eastern banner.
[cold, quiet] ...The eastern banner.
[nervous] Yes.
[voice tightening] The Kurosawa stood with the west. My brothers were on that field, Takeshi.
[defensive] I was a boy carrying a standard! I did not choose the side!
[angry, raising voice] Nobody chooses! That is what every man says after!
[shouting] Then what would you have me do? Apologize for four hundred years?
[shouting back] It would be a START!
[furious] I am going to the porch!
[yelling] The porch LOOPS, you idiot! You will walk right back in here!
[tired, sighs] ...He has been gone a long time. The hallways took him somewhere. Forgive the silence, listeners.
[quiet, emotional] I lied earlier. My sword is always in my hand because I never put it down. Not once since the field. If I put it down, the war is over. And then I would have to grieve.
[softly, near tears] My brothers had kind faces. Kenji laughed like a goose. [small laugh, crying] I have not said his name out loud in four hundred years.
[out of breath] I am back. I found it, Hana. The darker wall in the east wing. Travelers say it returns you to where you came from.
[alarmed] Takeshi. No.
[intense] If it takes me back to the field, I could change it. I could carry the standard the other way. Your brothers...
[desperate] Or it drops you in the dark and you are gone, and I am alone in this booth talking to static!
[quiet, surprised] ...You would miss me?
[frustrated, voice cracking] I would miss having someone to be angry at! That is the same thing, you stubborn ox!
[solemn] Then we settle it as samurai. A duel in the courtyard, by the hot spring. If I win, I go through the wall.
[steely] And if I win, you stay. And you sweep the porch for a year.
[scoffing] The porch is infinite.
[cold, smiling] Yes.
[roaring] AGREED!
[calm] Listeners, we will narrate. Takeshi has forgotten we only have one microphone.
[yelling from far away] Bring the microphone to the COURTYARD!
[breathing hard, focused] Dew on the grass. The waterfalls under the porch. He bows. [pause] I bow.
[strained, grunting] Her footwork... is better than... adequate!
[effort, grunts] You leave your left side open. You always have.
[shouting, falling] Gah! The SPRING! I am in the SPRING!
[laughing breathlessly] You stepped backward into the hot spring. In the middle of a duel.
[spluttering, then laughing] It was... wet. [laughs] I TOLD you the floor was wet!
[quiet, sincere] Hana. I am sorry for the field. For your brothers. For Kenji, who laughed like a goose.
[moved, soft] ...Thank you. [sighs] I am putting my sword on the rack, Takeshi. Next to yours.
[gently] Then the war is over.
[crying softly, then a small laugh] The war is over. And you still have a porch to sweep.
[groans] Forever.
[warm] Forever is not so bad. Not here.
[proud, warm] This is Kyoto Dreams Radio. Two samurai, one microphone, and a morning that never ends.
[warm] If you are lost, follow the smell of cedar and bamboo. The door is open. There is curry.
[shouting cheerfully] And if anyone writes on the rice again, I WILL FIND YOU!
[laughing] It was me, Takeshi.
[screaming] I KNOW IT WAS YOU!
